name: library-resource-exhaustion

finding.title: Decoding a `Vec` no longer bounds memory by the bytes read
finding.description: The PR removes `Take::new(r, MAX_VEC_SIZE)` from `Vec<T>::consensus_decode`, so `Vec::with_capacity(len)` trusts the length prefix of the stream. An element larger in memory than on the wire, such as an empty `Vec<u8>` (1 byte on the wire, 24 in memory), lets a 32 MB stream allocate about 768 MB. The new doc comment says callers bound the reader themselves, and no caller in the repository decodes untrusted bytes.
finding.suggestedFix: Keep the `Take` budget on the reader, or cap `with_capacity` by the bytes left.
